title: Nematic game
description: A playful 2D material lab with swirl, pull and comb brushes, liquid crystals, charged particles and optional discoveries.
intro: A material you can mess with. Give it a tiny tornado.
presetHint: Switch structure. Your settings stay put.
changeStructure: Change structure without resetting any parameter

modeHints.liquid: Free positions and independent orientations. Fields can still align the rods.
modeHints.nematic: Shared orientation, free positions. Alignment adds to this mode's base coupling.
modeHints.solid: Fixed lattice sites. Heat adds vibration and softens the springs.

display.title: Display
display.polarizedHint: An illustrative orientation filter: rods at 45° look brightest. It does not change the physics.

settlingDescription: The rods are finding their places.

presets.label: Liquid
presets.description: Loose, restless and terrible at following directions.

presets.label: Nematic
presets.description: Same axis. Still free to move around.

presets.label: Solid
presets.description: Settled into a lattice. Finally, some commitment.

parameters.label: Crowding
parameters.description: More rods in the same space.

parameters.label: Rod length
parameters.description: Changes molecular shape and collision spacing.

parameters.label: Alignment force
parameters.description: Adds to the structure's base alignment coupling.
parameters.modeHint: Kept for Nematic and Solid; Liquid has no alignment coupling.

extraParameters.label: Collision strength
extraParameters.description: How hard the rods push each other away.

extraParameters.label: Lattice stiffness
extraParameters.description: How firmly a solid returns to its lattice.

extraParameters.label: Brush strength
extraParameters.description: How strongly a brush disturbs the sample.

orderHint: Measured from the rods on screen.

fields.electricHint: Turns the rods. Positive and negative ions drift opposite ways.
fields.responseHint: Positive aligns along the field; negative aligns across it.
fields.inPlaneHint: Aligns the rods. Ions stay constrained to the sample plane.
fields.throughPlaneHint: Curves charged paths. Reverse the field to reverse the bend.
fields.chargeHint: Relative charge magnitude. 100% is the default.
fields.screeningHint: Shortens ion-to-ion forces. Zero leaves them unscreened.
fields.chargedHint: Equal positive and negative ions. Opposite charges attract.
fields.neutralHint: No charge: the tracers diffuse, collide and follow stirring.

modelNote: Illustrative 2D model. Structure prepares a sample without changing your settings: liquid has no orientational coupling, nematic has base coupling, solid keeps spring-bound sites. Heat drives noise and softens springs. Fields stay uniform; ion forces are softened and optionally screened. Distances and speeds use simulation pixels. No reaction chemistry or calculated equilibrium phase diagram. Brushes apply local forces or orientation changes. Crossed polarizers is an illustrative orientation filter.
accessibleLabel: Live material sample. Hold or drag to use the selected brush. Keys 1 to 4 select Stir, Swirl, Pull or Comb. Arrows move the brush; Space applies it. Escape pauses or resumes. The controls change the material, fields, and particles.
fallback: This playground needs JavaScript and a browser with Canvas support.

tools.title: Play with the sample
tools.hint: Pick a brush, then hold or drag on the sample.

stir.label: Stir
stir.hint: Drag to push. Tap to send a little shockwave.

swirl.label: Swirl
swirl.hint: Hold still to make a tiny tornado. The rods were not consulted.

pull.label: Pull
pull.hint: Hold to gather rods and ions. Personal space is optional.

comb.label: Comb
comb.hint: Drag to brush the rods along your path. Very small hairdressing.

tools.keyboard: Keys 1–4 choose a brush. Arrows move it. Space applies it. Escape pauses.

discoveries.title: Things to try
discoveries.saved: Discoveries stay in this browser. No deadlines.

items.title: Tiny tornado
items.hint: Use Swirl on a few rods for two seconds.

items.title: Molecular hairdresser
items.hint: Brush a few rods with Comb for two seconds.

items.title: A solid comeback
items.hint: Stir a Solid. Let it recover. Use less Heat.

items.title: Ion slalom
items.hint: Run Crossed fields with charged ions for two seconds.
